title: THE STASH BELT KEYS SHARE ONE ROW
why: Seen on the 4K stash screenshot of 2026-10-07: the TACTICAL BELT on the stash screen wrapped at his size, keys 1 to 8 in a row and key 9 alone on a line below, which reads as if key 9 were something else. The nine keys now always share one row, each shrinking to fit when it must and staying square.
now: The stash screen tactical belt always shows keys 1 to 9 in one row.
